stable_paths.target_context: Commercial Case proposal evidence before final proposal review

release_blockers: P0: 28 of 29 managed public tables have RLS disabled.
P0: all 29 managed public tables grant broad table privileges to anon and authenticated.
P0: production /app renders an unhandled response.
P0: production deployment has no discoverable Git SHA provenance.
P1: managed migrations lag the repository lockdown design.
required_consumer_behavior: Complete containment, access-log review, least-privilege grants, forced tenant RLS and managed negative probes before integration work is promoted.
Build one immutable attachment from exact Project, Room, selected-product, GeneratedDocument and Asset versions.
Bind tenantId, commercialCaseId and proposalContextVersionId from an authenticated API-issued integration context, never from arbitrary browser claims.
Require credential-bound human review, calculate the artifact SHA-256 digest and write one idempotent event to IntegrationOutbox.
Never declare prices authoritative or authorize customer send or binding acceptance.
Retry delivery from the outbox and reconcile acknowledgement/readback by event identity; do not post blindly.
acceptance_proof_needed: Git-bound preview with repaired /app and session lifecycle
fresh and upgrade migration proof plus rollback
exact artifact digest and superseded-version denial
independent API and UI consumer journey
known_limitations: This handoff does not apply the planner migration, change its deployment or assert that managed data was accessed.
The API attachment contract is producer-local until the planner and UI independently consume it.
